Q: Why session based authentication is no longer best practice? A:

The problem of cookie based authentication is caused by the mechanism of how cookies work. Cons of a cookie based authentication are as below:

  1. CORS. cookies + CORS don't play well across different domains.
  2. CSRF. you need to prevent your api from CSRF attack.
  3. Mobile platform. cookies is for web browser. You need to do extra work for mobile native platform which is hard to implement.

For more detail of this topic. The follow link is where you want to go Cookies vs Tokens. Getting auth right with Angular.JS

To keep it simple, perhaps each image could be arranged in a vertical manner, so when it needs to be split, it'll just have to split at each 600px interval (if each image height dimension is 600px).

Q: Order by column first alpha char then numeric char A:

You can use "TRANSLATE" function to create new sort order key

select * 
from epay
order by translate(EUNQ,'0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','123456789A00000000000000000000000000'),EUNQ

We translate for new sort key
0..9 ->1..A -- preserve digits order
A..Z ->0..0 -- A..Z to first position
And use EUNQ to sort A..Z in natural order.

For test data

eId   EUNQ           
---- ----------
  1  14579536       
  2  50118664       
  3  5PM35795  
  4  5AB35795

Output is

eId   EUNQ            new sort key                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
---- ------          --------------
   1 14579536        2568A647                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
   4 5AB35795        600468A6
   3 5PM35795        600468A6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
   2 50118664        61229775

Q: How to set a timestamp field default to current time (with seconds) in GBase 8s? A:

Use CURRENT with the same precision as your column.

created_at DATETIME YEAR TO SECOND DEFAULT CURRENT YEAR TO SECOND

That will auto-fill values like 2023-08-08 10:00:00 on insert.
